views.label: The shape is turned
views.note: Turning the shape round is the whole difference from a correlation. For a shape that reads the same both ways, nothing changes.

views.label: Multiply and add
views.note: At every place the overlapping samples are multiplied and added. That single sum is the whole operation.

views.label: What the ends rest on
views.note: Outside itself the signal is taken to be nothing, thus the ends of the full and same answers are assumed rather than measured.

views.label: How long the answer is
views.note: Full keeps every place, same lines up with the input, and valid keeps only what was measured.

cards.title: What it works out
items: y[n] = sum over k of x[n-k] * h[k]
Passing a signal through a filter is this operation
A mean over a window is this, with a shape of equal values

cards.title: How the library gets there
items: The minus in x[n-k] is the only difference from a correlation
For a long shape the bins are multiplied instead, which costs n*log(n) and not n*m
No conjugate is taken there, and that again is what parts it from a correlation

cards.title: What will catch you
items: A shape that reads the same both ways hides the difference until one does not
Full and same build their ends from a signal taken to be zero outside itself
Valid assumes nothing, and is shorter than the input by m-1
